market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Bond selloff and oil-driven inflation fears dominate. Equities under pressure from rising discount rates. Expect volatility 15-20% VIX range. Key risk: further yield spike triggers forced deleveraging. Meta $2T and AI names provide partial support but breadth is dangerously narrow.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle and productivity gains support earnings growth. Defense spending structural. However, rate environment and geopolitical fragmentation cap multiples. 6-12 month: expect rotation from mega-cap AI into defense, energy, diagnostics, and value. US-China truce provides 2-month window for risk-on.
